## Goal
- Implement and verify a fail-closed autonomous deployment-certification gate: deploy jobs complete only with approved-branch GitHub commit, real Render deployment, `/health` and `/version` receipts, full SHA parity, and explicit PASS/FAIL evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Never expose passwords, JWTs, token values, keystores, Base64 material, or production secrets.
- Do not certify IVX IA until a real owner-authorized source-change-to-production task produces the complete evidence chain.
- Deploy jobs may target only the approved production branch; reject `ivx-autonomous`.
- A deploy task must return Git commit SHA, Render deployment ID, production commit SHA, `/health` response, `/version` response, and PASS or FAIL.
- Any missing, mismatched, interrupted, or failed verification must end as `FAILED`, never `COMPLETED`.
- Production Android signing must not use `androiddebugkey` or `signingConfigs.debug`; QA/debug APKs must not be called production releases.

## Progress
### Done
- Confirmed prior public GitHub/Render production parity:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  fix(android): isolate disposable QA signing and launch QA package
  ```
- Confirmed production `/health` was healthy and served:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health
  HTTP=200
  status=healthy
  environment=production
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Confirmed production AI gateway/provider evidence was substantive and ready:
  ```text
  CHAT_OK=True
  CHAT_SOURCE=chatgpt
  CHAT_MODEL=openai/gpt-4o
  providerState=PROVIDER_READY
  lastHttpStatus=200
  credentialValid=true
  providerReady=true
  ```
- Confirmed production runtime credential reachability:
  ```text
  GITHUB_PUSH=True
  RENDER_DEPLOY=True
  executionPath=github_git_data_api
  ```
- Obtained owner authentication and confirmed canonical worker endpoints:
  ```text
  /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/active HTTP=200 OK=True
  /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs HTTP=200 OK=True
  /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/ledger HTTP=200 OK=True
  ```
- Submitted prior owner-authorized deploy task:
  ```text
  JOB_ID=ivx-worker-ce531801-bb61-4e07-bbe8-2f8348675a8a
  executionMode=deploy
  templateMode=BUG_FIX
  ```
- Audited its unsafe result:
  ```text
  commitSha=27c452b53fd9d809dc6be99c06d998ca45135999
  branch=ivx-autonomous
  deployId=null
  deployVerified=false
  finalStatus=COMPLETE
  ```
- Confirmed the unsafe recovery message:
  ```text
  Recovered from COMMITTING crash: GitHub evidence confirms commit 27c452b landed on ivx-autonomous. Job completed.
  ```
- Previously implemented initial worker hardening:
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder.ts` resolves deploy-mode commit branch from `GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH` and rejects a commit result not on that approved branch.
  - Successful rollback after failed verification now remains `FAILED`, not `COMPLETED`.
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` rejects deploy proof unless branch is `main`, `deployId` exists, `deployStatus === 'live'`, health is healthy, and live commit equals requested commit.
  - Recovery no longer completes deploy jobs from GitHub commit evidence alone.
  - Synthetic `auto_deploy_on_commit` deployment IDs were removed.
- Added initial regression tests in `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts` for:
  - `ivx-autonomous` deploy proof rejection;
  - missing Render deployment ID rejection;
  - non-live Render deploy status rejection.
- Earlier focused validation passed:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  bun test backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts backend/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts backend/verify-live-commit-match.test.ts
  ```
- Updated `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md` to state the deployment gate is implemented but IVX IA is not certified pending a new complete owner-authorized production evidence chain.
- Began extending the autonomous-coder proof contract with secret-safe endpoint receipts:
  ```ts
  IVXDeploymentEndpointEvidence {
    endpoint
    httpStatus
    commitSha
    ok
  }
  ```
- Began adding production verification that combines:
  ```text
  verifyLiveCommitMatch(...)
  /health
  /version
  ```
  and requires `deployStatus === 'live'` plus matching GitHub/health/version SHAs.
- Began adding worker-result fields:
  ```text
  healthResponse
  versionResponse
  ```
  and stricter proof gates requiring both endpoint receipts and requested-SHA parity.

### In Progress
- Repair and complete the new `IVXAutonomousCoderProof` endpoint-evidence implementation.
- Complete fail-closed deploy recovery behavior and ensure no stale recovery path can recreate certification from later partial evidence.
- Add deterministic tests for missing `/health`, missing `/version`, endpoint SHA mismatch, and recovery failure semantics.
- Run TypeScript/tests after repair, then perform a new owner-authorized deploy only if all local gates pass.

### Blocked
- Current TypeScript validation fails because two early-return proof constructors do not yet populate the newly required fields:
  ```text
  backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder.ts(303,3): error TS2739: Type '{ ... }' is missing the following properties from type 'IVXAutonomousCoderProof': healthResponse, versionResponse
  backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder.ts(1505,5): error TS2739: Type '{ ... }' is missing the following properties from type 'IVXAutonomousCoderProof': healthResponse, versionResponse
  ```
- No new authenticated source-change-to-live-production lifecycle has been run after the gate changes.
- No full current deployment evidence chain exists:
  ```text
  GitHub commit SHA
  Render deployment ID
  Render live status
  /health response and matching SHA
  /version response and matching SHA
  PASS
  ```
- Previous deploy task committed to forbidden branch:
  ```text
  ivx-autonomous
  ```
- Previous deploy task had no auditable Render deployment:
  ```text
  deployId=null
  deployVerified=false
  ```
- Production still remained on:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
  and did not contain the previously requested health provider fields.
- `functions.runChecks` iOS build remains independently blocked:
  ```text
  Swift template UI sources still match createApp or retain its placeholder copy.
  - IVXHoldings/ContentView.swift
  ```
- GitHub Actions fail before runner assignment:
  ```text
  JOB_STATUS=completed
  JOB_CONCLUSION=failure
  RUNNER_ID=0
  STEPS=0
  ```
- Production Android release certification remains blocked pending:
  ```text
  IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64
  IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
  IVX_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS
  IVX_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Treat a deploy job as `FAILED` unless all deployment certification predicates are present in the same worker proof.
- Require approved production branch `main` in worker proof validation; `ivx-autonomous` cannot represent a production deployment.
- Require a real Render deployment ID and `deployStatus === 'live'`; synthetic deployment IDs are forbidden.
- Require separate secret-safe `/health` and `/version` receipts, each with HTTP status, endpoint, commit SHA, and success state.
- Require GitHub commit SHA parity with both endpoint commit SHAs; `liveCommit` is derived from `/version`.
- A restarted/interrupted deploy task must fail closed because later production polling cannot recreate the original atomic Render → endpoint evidence chain.
- Preserve commit evidence for audit, but never use GitHub commit evidence alone to complete a deploy job.
- Do not certify IVX IA until an actual owner-authorized production run returns full PASS evidence.

## Next Steps
1. Add `healthResponse: null` and `versionResponse: null` to all `IVXAutonomousCoderProof` early-return constructors, including `buildCanceledProof(...)` and the second failing proof construction near line 1505.
2. Inspect all remaining `IVXAutonomousCoderProof` object literals and test fixtures; populate endpoint evidence or make it consistently nullable.
3. Review `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder.ts` production verification to ensure Render polling waits through completion, captures real `deployId`, and rejects status/error/parity failures.
4. Review `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` recovery branches around `recoverStuckVerifyingJobs(...)`; ensure deploy/`approveGitDeploy` jobs always fail closed after interruption.
5. Update `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts` fixture `autonomousProof(...)` with valid `/health` and `/version` evidence.
6. Add focused tests for:
   - missing `/health` evidence;
   - missing `/version` evidence;
   - unhealthy endpoint;
   - endpoint SHA mismatch;
   - `productionVerified=false`;
   - recovery cannot complete interrupted deploy task.
7. Run:
   ```text
   bunx tsc --noEmit
   bun test backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts backend/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts backend/verify-live-commit-match.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts
   ```
8. Update `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md` with final validation status.
9. Only then submit a new owner-authorized deploy task and report PASS solely with complete live evidence.

## Critical Context
- Latest failed-certification job:
  ```text
  ivx-worker-ce531801-bb61-4e07-bbe8-2f8348675a8a
  ```
- Commit created by that job:
  ```text
  27c452b53fd9d809dc6be99c06d998ca45135999
  ```
- Incorrect target branch:
  ```text
  ivx-autonomous
  ```
- The autonomous coder now imports:
  ```ts
  import { verifyLiveCommitMatch } from './ivx-senior-developer-runtime';
  ```
  to combine Render polling with endpoint verification.
- New autonomous-coder types introduced:
  ```ts
  IVXDeploymentEndpointEvidence
  healthResponse
  versionResponse
  ```
- New production verification logic currently calls:
  ```ts
  verifyProductionDeployment(commitSha, deployId)
  ```
  which invokes `verifyLiveCommitMatch({ requestedCommit: commitSha, deploymentId })`, then reads:
  ```text
  ${baseUrl}/health
  ${baseUrl}/version
  ```
- `readDeploymentEndpoint(...)` stores only endpoint, HTTP status, `commit`, and success state; it does not retain response body secrets.
- Current proof completion predicate is intended to be:
  ```text
  deployStatus === 'live'
  healthResponse.ok
  versionResponse.ok
  healthResponse.commitSha === commitSha
  versionResponse.commitSha === commitSha
  ```
- Existing `verifyLiveCommitMatch(...)` polls Render deployment state and reads `/version` or `/health` commit fallback, but it does not itself retain both endpoint receipts.
- `verifyProductionHealth()` remains in `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder.ts`; the new deploy path is being moved away from its health-only behavior.
- The worker’s prior proof gate already requires:
  ```text
  proof.branch === 'main'
  proof.deployId
  proof.deployStatus === 'live'
  proof.healthOk
  proof.productionVerified
  proof.liveCommit === proof.commitSha
  ```
  and is being extended to require `healthResponse` and `versionResponse`.
- Runtime confirmation constants:
  ```text
  IVX_SAFE_PATCH_CONFIRM_TEXT='CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH'
  IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_CONFIRM_TEXT='CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR'
  ```
- Worker enqueue canonicalizes approved deploy confirmation as:
  ```text
  gitDeployConfirmationText: 'CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY'
  ```
- Worker uses GitHub Git Data API:
  ```text
  Git Data API (blobs → trees → commits → ref PATCH)
  ```
- Current local checkout:
  ```text
  LOCAL_HEAD=18295da7528fc6543acc2e34ae3201454a6e71dd
  origin=https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- Local and public GitHub sources differ.
- Android QA APK remains QA-only/debug-signed:
  ```text
  expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/qa/app-qa.apk
  package: name='com.ivxholdings.app.qa' versionCode='92' versionName='1.9.4-qa'
  Signer #1 certificate DN: C=US, O=Android, CN=Android Debug
  ```

## Relevant Files
- `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder.ts`: autonomous patch/commit/deploy flow; currently has incomplete required `healthResponse`/`versionResponse` proof construction.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: durable queue, proof summarization, terminal-state enforcement, recovery, and ledger contract.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`: GitHub Git Data API, Render polling, and `verifyLiveCommitMatch(...)`.
- `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: owner-gated worker enqueue/job/ledger API.
- `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts`: autonomous-proof summary tests; fixture needs endpoint evidence fields.
- `backend/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts`: worker queue and terminal-state regression tests.
- `backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts`: autonomous coder deploy/commit behavior tests; add injected production-verifier coverage.
- `backend/verify-live-commit-match.test.ts`: deterministic Render/live-version parity tests.
- `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md`: certification plan/status record.
- `backend/hono.ts`: local `/health` provider-readiness correction not included in prior worker commit.
- `backend/ivx-ai-runtime.ts`: AI gateway configuration and provider-state transitions.
- `backend/services/ivx-provider-state-machine.ts`: provider readiness state machine.
- `backend/tests/ivx-provider-state-machine.test.ts`: provider-state regression tests.
- `expo/android/app/build.gradle`: QA/release signing separation.
- `.github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml`: QA assemble/emulator/Maestro workflow.
- `.github/workflows/android-production-signing.yml`: protected production-signing workflow.

responseMessageContents.title: Improving the app's update process and fixing security issues.
responseMessageContents.description: We checked the app's security settings and fixed errors that were preventing new versions from being tested. We also created a strict checklist to make sure every update is fully working and verified before it reaches users. We are currently focusing on making the system more stable so that it can automatically detect and fix problems.
